changes.title: Renewed calls for Trump-backed Kennedy Center repairs after part of foyer ceiling falls
changes.summary: No one was injured when a piece of the ceiling inside the Kennedy Center's grand foyer partially collapsed Friday evening, said Roma Daravi, the center's vice president for public relations.

changes.title: Opinion: A sculpture in perpetual motion, removed
changes.summary: "Blue," a statue that's been on the grounds of the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. for 7 years has been dismantled and removed. (Image credit: Mark Schiefelbein).
